_comment: TESTNET GENESIS TEMPLATE. Every address below is an unfilled placeholder and the node WILL REFUSE TO START until each is replaced (config.go::SafetyCheck rejects any address matching the template placeholder shape under a non-localnet profile). Previously this file shipped seven distinct fake addresses chosen so the old single-address check would pass, which meant a half-filled copy booted happily; the placeholders are now collectively recognizable instead.

params._comment: Multisig signers and thresholds for testnet. 3-of-5; treasuryThreshold lowered to 50_000_000 uCPLQ so the multisig branch is actually exercised on modest testnet spends. All five signers must be distinct: ValidateParams rejects duplicates.

_validatorRegistryComment: Shipped empty for first testnet bring-up (2026-06-18 decision). The plugin falls back to a single committee aggregator key, which obscures per-validator pro-rata reward credit; populate before the validator-eject T1 scenarios and before mainnet.
